checks.description: The fourth refinery was ordered with three refineries standing and no hq/eye/tmpl: the Economy rung firing in its new place ahead of the tech. Last fight it was ordered at 246s behind hq, so this id could not fire. Absent means a match that never stood three refineries, or the swap did not take.

Priority 1's per-harvester metric. Last fight 13.82 overall; over 0-480s 14.9 against the opponent's 20.6 on equal harvester-seconds (1,775 v 1,787), and 10.3 against 23.8 over 240-300s while the fleet hauled 22 cells for the 95s before refinery four stood at 335s.
Priority 1's headline metric. Last fight 60.5, but 84-100 until 480s; every loss on record before it was 41 or less and every win 71 or more. Diagnostic: dominated by the match outcome.

hq now waits behind refinery four and the harvester recovery hold (release at six harvesters with four refineries). Last fight it stood at 245s; expected about 320-360s. Past 400s the swap is starving e2/e4, the siege rung and atwr.
Moving the refinery ahead of the tech must not shrink the fleet. Last fight peaked at 8 against the opponent's 11.
No fight may run past the benchmark's 2,400s limit. A timed-out benchmark game voids its pair, and three voided pairs stop training.
